sentences.text: Otter Marine Operations Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-07 under the industry code 52229, other service activities incidental to water transportation.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-07, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-12.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is a water transport service on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
